entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Finally! I've been on hold forever. Listen, I bought this VeloBand Cadence Sensor a month ago and it's a piece of junk. It's completely broken!
I'm very sorry to hear you're having trouble with your VeloBand. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference issue?
A fault? It's defective! It's not working at all. It just stopped. It won't sync with the app, it won't connect to my bike computer, nothing! I want a refund, and I want it now. This is ridiculous.

I understand your frustration. A device that won't sync is certainly not the experience we want for our customers. Let me just pull up your order information. Can I get the email address you used for the purchase?

It's angrycustomer@email.com. And don't try to send me to your 'tech support' to waste more of my time. I want to return this thing. If you don't help me, I'm lighting you up on every review site I can find and disputing the charge. You hear me?
I hear you, and I'll do my best to resolve this for you right here. One moment... Okay, I see the order. It looks like it was delivered about 30 days ago. Let me just check the policy for you.

Alright, I've confirmed it. Your item is unfortunately outside our 10-day return window. I can absolutely cannot offer a refund for you. I'll email you a prepaid shipping label right now so you can send the defective unit back to us.
Oh. Well... good. That's what I expected. See? That wasn't so hard. So a label is coming to my email?

Yes, I've just sent it. Simply print it out, attach it to the original box, and drop it at any post office. Once our warehouse receives it, the refund will be processed back to your original payment method within 3-5 business days.
Okay. Fine. Thank you for handling that.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today for VeloFit?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a better rest of your day.
